title: Kionga pipeline run log batch
description: Body of POST /api/v1/pipelines/runs/{id}/logs, runner output for one run. Entries are attributed to the run's project, never to caller-supplied scope. Open contract (see docs/compatibility.md): the gateway accepts and ignores properties it does not know, so a newer producer never fails against an older gateway.

stream.description: stdout or stderr. Without a known severity, stderr is logged as warn.

severity.description: debug, info, warn or error. The gateway logs any other value as info (warn for stderr).

message.description: The gateway truncates messages longer than 8 KiB.
